user.title: MVM Next Energy Import
user.description: Choose the directory where you copy the downloaded MVM Next CSV export files.

error.invalid_dir: The given directory could not be created or is not accessible.

menu_options.upload: Upload and import a CSV file

folder.title: Import directory
folder.description: The directory the integration scans for *.csv files. On recent HaOS the config folder is reached at `/homeassistant` (not `/config`), e.g. `/homeassistant/mvm_next`. Saving re-runs the import.

pricing.title: Cost calculation
pricing.description: Alongside consumption an `mvm_next:imported_cost` statistic is pushed in the currency configured in Home Assistant (set it to HUF). Tiered household tariff: the reduced unit price up to the yearly allowance, the market price above it. The allowance resets every calendar year. Saving re-computes every past import.

data.price_high: Market price above the allowance (HUF/kWh, gross)

upload.title: Upload MVM Next CSV
upload.description: Pick the downloaded MVM Next CSV export file. After upload it is stored in the import directory and the statistic is refreshed immediately.

done.title: Upload complete

error.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
error.invalid_dir: The given directory could not be created or is not accessible.

import.name: Import MVM CSV
import.description: Reads the MVM Next CSV export files from the configured directory and updates the long-term statistic.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Optional: force re-processing of a single CSV file.

upload.name: Upload MVM CSV
upload.description: Uploads a CSV file from the browser into the import directory and processes it immediately.

file.name: CSV file
file.description: The MVM Next CSV export file to upload.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Optional: name for the file saved into the directory. If left empty, the uploaded file's original name is kept.
